configuration_boundary.scene_facts_requirement: Targets, target regions, object identities, and other required scene facts must be supplied through the run's approved observation interface.
configuration_boundary.object_scope: Small, lightweight tabletop objects and fixtures inside the admitted reachable workspace.

difficulty_scale.D1: One direct motion or broad-tolerance contact; no stable grasp or multi-stage manipulation.
difficulty_scale.D2: One controlled interaction, stable grasp, or simple fixture transition with generous tolerance.
difficulty_scale.D3: Multiple manipulation phases, transport/release, pose maintenance, or moderately constrained geometry.
difficulty_scale.D4: Tight alignment, constrained contact, articulated pulling, multi-object ordering, clutter, or tool use.

tasks.description: Move the gripper reference point to the specified 3-D target and stop.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Direct positioning with no grasp.

tasks.description: Touch the specified face of the target object without moving the object.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Short contact motion, but it requires contact evidence.

tasks.description: Push the cube into the specified planar goal region.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Broad-tolerance planar motion without grasping.

tasks.description: Push the cylinder laterally into the specified goal region while keeping it upright.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Contact direction and cylinder stability must both be controlled.

tasks.description: Roll the ball into the specified circular goal region.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Object motion continues after contact, requiring anticipation.

tasks.description: Rotate the rectangular block to the specified planar orientation without moving it outside its local region.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires selecting contact points to control yaw.

tasks.description: Push the T-shaped block until it matches the target silhouette.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Translation and yaw must be controlled through repeated contact.

tasks.description: Grasp the target cube and hold it securely just above the table.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Tests stable stock-gripper closure without long transport.

tasks.description: Lift the target cube to the specified height and hold it there.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Stable grasp plus vertical motion.

tasks.description: Move the grasped cube to the specified 3-D goal and keep holding it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Combines grasp stability with multi-joint spatial transport.

tasks.description: Place the cube on the specified planar target and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires transport, controlled descent, release, and settling.

tasks.description: Place the cube completely inside the shallow tray and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires clearance-aware placement and release.

tasks.description: Place the sphere inside the shallow bin and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Release can cause rolling or escape.

tasks.description: Place the cylinder upright on the specified target and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Position, symmetry-axis orientation, and release stability all matter.

tasks.description: Stack the target cube on top of the base cube and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Sensitive to depth error and release disturbance.

tasks.description: Raise the horizontal peg to an upright pose and release it on the table.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires a large orientation change and stable release.

tasks.description: Place the square ring over the specified square peg and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Position and yaw must align throughout insertion.

tasks.description: Insert the specified end of the peg into the side hole.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Contact-rich alignment is difficult for a five-DoF arm; pilot required.

tasks.description: Put the specified shape into its matching sorter slot and release it.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires object selection, yaw alignment, and constrained insertion.

tasks.description: Press the specified large button until it activates.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Short motion, but contact direction and target discrimination matter.

tasks.description: Open the shallow drawer by its handle.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Handle acquisition and constrained pulling are workspace-sensitive; pilot required.

tasks.description: Push the shallow drawer fully closed.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Broad frontal pushing is easier than handle-based opening.

tasks.description: Slide the tabletop door to its fully open position.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires sustained constrained contact along one axis.

tasks.description: Grasp the lid handle and remove the lid from the container.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires stable handle grasp and vertical clearance.

tasks.description: Place each of the two specified objects into its matching tray.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Two complete pick-and-place cycles with distinct destinations.

tasks.description: Place object A into the tray, then place object B into the tray.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires memory of task order and two reliable manipulation cycles.

tasks.description: Put the specified object inside the open drawer and then close the drawer.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Combines pick-and-place, containment, and articulated manipulation.

tasks.description: Use the provided tool to pull the initially unreachable cube into the specified reachable region.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Requires tool grasp, indirect contact, and compound planning; pilot required.
